errors.text_span: The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)," is a linear scale ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁷
errors.evidence: The x-axis is logarithmic (powers of 2), not linear. Also, the range goes from 2⁰ to 2⁸, not 2⁷ — the last tick visible is 2⁸.

errors.text_span: with tick labels spaced by approximately 0.02
errors.evidence: The y-axis tick labels appear to be spaced by 0.1 (0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6), not 0.02.

errors.text_span: A solid purple line represents the accuracy voting, beginning near 0.3 at k=2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.48 at k=2⁷
errors.evidence: The figure shows two groups of lines: a higher-performing group (dark blue/teal and green, reaching ~0.6) and a lower-performing group (light blue/teal and light green, reaching ~0.45). There is no clearly distinguishable 'purple' line. The description misidentifies line colors and misreports their values.

errors.text_span: A solid light blue line represents the accuracy voting, beginning around 0.38 at k=2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.44 at k=2⁷. A solid green line represents the accuracy voting, beginning around 0.4 at k=2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.55 at k=2⁷.
errors.evidence: The figure shows 4 lines total: two higher-performing lines (dark blue circle markers and dark green triangle markers, reaching ~0.6) and two lower-performing lines (light blue circle markers and light green triangle markers, reaching ~0.45). The description only describes 3 lines and incorrectly characterizes their colors and values.

The description does not mention that there are 4 lines total, nor does it mention the marker shapes (circles for blue lines, triangles for green lines), nor the presence of dashed vs solid line styles that appear in the plot.

errors.text_span: beginning near 0.3 at k=2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.48 at k=2⁷
errors.evidence: The two top lines (dark blue and dark green) start at approximately 0.45 and reach approximately 0.6 at k=2⁸. The bottom lines start around 0.28-0.32 and reach approximately 0.45. None of the lines match the described start/end values for a 'purple' line.
The y-axis label is 'Majority voting accuracy' without a percentage sign — the values shown (0.3–0.6) are proportions, not percentages.
